verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used for model training is a fair privacy question for a voice-AI SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no data-use policy. The per-agent data retention feature (automatic deletion of call and chat data) is an adjacent control, not a training-use prevention capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
